summary: Round 15 (clean worktree at 89fd6bb, which includes 63f9336). My own q06 from the clean build matches the harness q06 (mean diff 0.09/255), so the harness renders are current. Against w14 the pixel diff is q06 9.5 %, q07 19 %, q08 3 %, q09 6.5 %, q10 4 %, and 1-4 % in the studio. Fixed or improved: (1) The buckle is now a real lift-lever buckle, a silver plate with a dark lever slot on the teal belt, and a latch tongue and webbing stub sit on the open cushion (o1). (2) Cabinet ash is darker greige: q06 cabinet (151,138,119), was (170,161,148); c_27312 is (127,115,99). The q06 table (164,157,144) now matches c_27312 (166,152,136). (3) In the studio the aisle-end doors are near-plain cream (o6 door hp 0.024, r2 0.030), as in c_27314. (4) The pillow is a little more navy (q08 R/G 0.78, was 0.83). Still keeping the area below 8.5: (a) The ash grain is now coarse and blotchy, with dark smudged 1-3 cm bands that read as weathered oak or driftwood (q07, o4, q06 cabinets). The real ash is a fine, even pinstripe (c_27312, c_27314, c_27316, tpg_81). (b) In the cabin the aisle-end door panels still render grey-cream with visible fine streaks: q06 post (167 luminance, hp 0.14) against cabinet 140 is a ratio of 0.84, while c_27312 has 0.6. Part of this is the light falling on the aisle faces. (c) The pillows are still rigid bevelled slabs; the white pillow reads as a seat cushion (q09, r7, r10). (d) The O comforter is still a crisp T or cross in r9, with only small new drape ridges. (e) The pillow is still over-saturated in the cabin (B/G 2.28 against kn_17 1.92). Lighting (not scored): the sofa fabric reads lilac in the studio (r7), the shells read light slate in q10, and the q07 table is too pale (195 against c_27316 168).

issues.detail: Ash grain is coarse and blotchy (weathered-oak smudges), not the fine even pinstripe of THE Room ash
issues.problem: The darker base #b2a28b at PHOTO_GAIN[19] 2.6 brings out the low-frequency blotches in the j_ash tile. The cabinets and table inlays show dark, smudged 1-3 cm bands with brown blobs. In every real photo the veneer is a fine, regular, straight streak pattern at low amplitude, with no blotches.
issues.evidence: ash_cmp.png: c_27312, c_27316, c_27314 and tpg_81 crops (fine pinstripe) against the q07 cabinet (130-340 x 200-390), o4 (500-640 x 90-250) and the q06 cabinet (185-290 x 340-440), all with coarse dark smears. The tone is now right (q06 cabinet (151,138,119) against c_27312 (127,115,99)).
issues.fix: 03_tex.js (shared, one line each): PHOTO_GAIN[19] 2.6 -> 1.8, and LAYER_PARAMS[19] tile scale 1.6 -> 2.2 for finer streaks. Better, in test/make_swatches.py, re-cut j_ash with a high-pass across the grain only: subtract a Gaussian blur (sigma ~6 px across, ~40 px along the grain) before normalising, so the blotches go and only the pinstripe remains. Keep #b2a28b.

issues.detail: In the cabin the aisle-end door panels still read grey-cream and streaky, too close in tone to the cabinets
issues.problem: In the studio, layer 30 makes the doors near-plain cream. In q06, q08 and q10 the aisle faces render at ~167 luminance with visible fine streaks, a ratio of 0.84 to the cabinets. In c_27312 and c_27314 the doors are clearly the brightest wood in the scene (ratio 0.6), cream and near plain.
issues.fix: 09c line 25: ashDoor c '#e4ddd0' -> '#ece7dc', r 0.44 -> 0.5. 03_tex.js (shared): PHOTO_GAIN[30] 1.0 -> 0.6. Check with the lighting owner whether the aisle faces are under-lit (the AO volume over the aisle?) before going brighter still.

issues.problem: Unchanged. Real pillows (kn_17, tpg_81) are puffy, with pinched dog-ear corners and soft creases. The white pillow reads as a seat cushion.
issues.fix: 09c roomPillow: build from a 36x24 grid with thickness T*(1-|2u-1|^4)*(1-|2v-1|^4)^0.6 + 0.004 and 2 sine wrinkles (A 3 mm); keep the flange loft. Tilt seat pillows back ~15 deg onto the bundle.

issues.detail: O comforter still a crisp T or cross
issues.problem: The drape got a little wave, but the tongue's edges are straight cuts and the corners are square. tpg_81 shows soft, irregular edges and broad loose folds.
issues.fix: 09c duvetSheet (O): add 0.03*sin(9*z + 1.3) + 0.02*sin(23*z) to the tongue's x edges as well as the wide part's, round the outline corners (r 0.06), and add f += 0.015*exp(-((d - k*0.25)/0.05)^2) diagonal folds for k = 0..2.

issues.problem: The crease glints added in w14 cannot be seen in any view: the bundle sits under the pillow.
issues.fix: Move the blue pillow ~6 cm back or tilt it more so a ~10 cm strip of the bundle shows in front, as in kn_17, then check the glints.
